content_sections.heading: NIT Delhi Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NIT Delhi Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Associate / Research Associate posts at NIT Delhi is scheduled for 11 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total number of vacancies available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Project Associate and Research Associate positions at the National Institute of Technology Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: For the Project Associate position, candidates need to have a B.E./ B.Tech. or M.E./ M.Tech. degree in ECE / Electronics / Telecommunication Engineering or an M.Sc. in Electronics / Physics.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis apply for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) / Physics with a focus on Antennas, RF, or Microwave Engineering are eligible to apply for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview, followed by a decision from an Expert Panel, and finally, Document Verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the National Institute of Technology Delhi. The exact address details can be found in the official notification PDF.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Is there an age limit for the Project Associate / Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits for these positions. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any specific age criteria or relaxation details.
